links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across 30 repeated runs per question, measured by concordance coefficient
links.effect: Gemini showed better response stability with a concordance coefficient of κ = 0.62 compared with κ = 0.46 for ChatGPT.
links.quote: Gemini showed better response stability with a concordance coefficient of κ = 0.62 compared with κ = 0.46 for ChatGPT.

links.outcome: Factual accuracy of LLM responses to prosthodontics questions rated by three examiners
links.effect: Models showed difficulties with specialized terminology and complex concepts, with occasional hallucinations and erroneous or incomplete responses. Mean accuracy difference between models not significant (p = 0.109).
links.quote: Both models showed difficulties with specialized terminology and complex concepts, with the occasional presence of hallucinations and erroneous or incomplete responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT and Gemini on prosthodontics questions scored by experts, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
